description.value:
Segmented black steel plate over a padded coat — chest, shoulders, forearms, shins — the pattern a pre-Fall riot line wore and a hex constabulary still does. Heavy, loud, and very hard to argue with. The wearer gives up quickness for the certainty that the first swing lands on steel.

No signature, no harmonization. Clatters on stairs.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Heavy
  • Defense: Guard +5, Evasion -1
  • Requires: Plating (trained)
  • Tier: III
  • Cost: 105 Nonlethal marks

⟡ Circuited (+2). A closed circuit of sigils; it answers one hand.

  • +2 on each of its defense bonuses → Guard +5 (rank-scaled like all armor: Trained half, Proficient full).
  • Grade raises it to Tier III · attuned (one slot).

item.signature: Built for a crowd that has stopped listening.
